get.description: Returns all routing rules attached to the gateway.

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

200.description: List of routing rules for the gateway.

rules.description: Routing configuration. `headers` is only present for `Header-Based` strategy.

post.description:
Adds a new routing rule to the gateway.

| `routing_strategy` | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `Weight-Based` | Distributes traffic according to the `weight` assigned to each endpoint. |
| `Prefix-Based` | Routes requests by URL path prefix. All referenced endpoints must be in `READY` status. |
| `Header-Based` | Routes requests by matching HTTP request headers. |
| `Path-Based` | Routes requests by matching the full URL path. |

parameters.name: active_iam
parameters.description: Active IAM ID **(To access contact person account)** [**Find your Active IAM ID here**](/paths/users-iam-accounts/get)

route_name.description: Name of the routing rule. Must be unique within the gateway.

routing_strategy.description:
Traffic routing strategy.
- `Weight-Based` — distributes traffic by weight across endpoints.
- `Prefix-Based` — routes by URL path prefix. All referenced endpoints must be in `READY` status.
- `Header-Based` — routes by matching HTTP request headers.
- `Path-Based` — routes by matching the full URL path.

path.description: URL path to match (used in `Prefix-Based` and `Path-Based`).

endpoints.description: List of inference endpoints to route traffic to. Retrieve available endpoint IDs from the [Model Endpoints List](/operations/list-model-endpoints) API (`GET /teams/{Team_Id}/projects/{Project_Id}/serving/inference/`).

id.description: ID of the inference endpoint. Obtain this from the [Model Endpoints List](/operations/list-model-endpoints) API (`GET /teams/{Team_Id}/projects/{Project_Id}/serving/inference/`).
